create_EvidenceStore: create an EvidenceStore instance from a JSON filepath that persists evidence entries across reloads
add_evidence_entry: add an evidence entry with source, content, type, actor, and optional URL to the store and return its ID
list_evidence_filtered: list evidence entries filtered by type or actor from the store
query_evidence_keyword: query evidence entries by keyword searching content, source, actor, and notes fields case-insensitively
verify_evidence_integrity: verify SHA-256 integrity of all evidence entries and report mismatches
